insight: Founded in 2017 by former Dealer.com executives; raised a $40M Series A in 2025 and now powers about $3B in annual ad spend.
name: Fluency
tagline: A 'Digital Advertising Operating System' that runs thousands of ad campaigns with agentic AI.
description: Fluency is a digital advertising platform — a self-described Digital Advertising Operating System — that automates campaign creation, management, and optimization at scale across Google, Meta, TikTok, Amazon, and more. Its Muse AI and agentic automation execute tactical optimizations with built-in governance, and campaigns can be generated dynamically from CRM and data sources. It targets agencies, enterprise brands, and multi-location businesses running large campaign volumes.
edge: Built for agencies and brands running thousands of ad campaigns at once — agentic optimizations with governance across every major ad channel.
